scope: SCH netlist vs PCB netlist vs live pads; native BOM and CPL semantic consistency only, no library accuracy or Gerber physical connectivity certification

rules.format: BOM/CPL are tab-separated UTF-8 with quote handling despite .csv suffix
rules.coordinates: snapshot mil × 0.0254, preserve signed Y; Mid/Ref tolerance 0.000051mm = half last exported 0.0001mm digit plus 1nm
rules.rotation: modulo 360; angular tolerance 1e-7 degree; no mirroring applied
rules.layer: snapshot layer 1 and PCB TopLayer must correspond to native CPL T
rules.NC: Only the literal empty string is an unassigned net; each blank pin remains a distinct endpoint. No empty-net pads are merged into one electrical network. Names such as NC, $1Nxx, NC1, NC2, or other aliases are compared literally and never treated as universally disconnected. Actual electrical isolation requires separate Gerber connectivity audit. This snapshot has 21 blank-net endpoints and zero differing aliases between sources.
rules.properties: MPN, supplier number, ID and footprint name compare literally. Footprint IDs only available and compared between SCH and PCB netlists; native BOM/CPL expose names, not IDs. Live snapshot contains identity/pads/placement only, no MPN fields. DeviceName is library device identity and is compared to CPL Device rather than assumed to equal MPN.
rules.values: R/C values literal equality across SCH, PCB, BOM and CPL; no unit substitution needed because representations match.

NC_endpoint_ledger.meaning: unassigned per endpoint; no electrical equivalence with any other blank-net pad
